law_name: Law on Copyright and Related Rights (Law HO-142-N of 15 June 2006, as amended to 2013)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous and collective works: from publication)
moral_rights: Authorship, name & integrity (inalienable; right of withdrawal ends at death)
digital_protection: WCT party: anti-circumvention protection required by WCT art. 11 (national rule not checked)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list of free uses with attribution (art. 22): quotation, criticism, education, research
